name: Loftus Farms
tagline: Loftus Farms prepares for strawberry season
description: Loftus Farms is a small pumpkin patch in Georgetown, IN. It grows Strawberries, Pumpkins, and Green beans, with picking through spring and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
